Department: Corporate

Location: Hong Kong

Description

This role will provide a comprehensive paralegal service to Ogier Hong Kong's Corporate Team, ensuring that the fee earners within the team are fully supported.

Key Responsibilities

  • Undertaking work in support of a team of fee earners, meeting an agreed target chargeable hours
  • Undertaking various due diligence work and searches at the request of fee-earner
  • Drafting, amending and translating legal documents at the request of fee-earners
  • Primary line of communication between fee-earners and clients
  • Ensuring that all new client matters are accurately set up in the client accounting and database system
  • Maintaining and amending client records and contact names where appropriate
  • Ensuring files are kept up to date (including filing of documents, emails and correspondence) when active and that files are closed/archived once the matter is concluded following instruction from the relevant fee-earner
  • Delegating certain administration tasks received from the fee-earners as per the specific team workflow model
  • Providing complete assistance to all fee-earners and clients regarding various legal issues
  • Leading the way with innovation, technology and tools by supporting and trialling new initiatives
  • Primary contact for team-specific legal and business services queries as the embedded team support
  • Screen incoming telephone calls, taking and relaying accurate messages where necessary. Where appropriate, arrange and set up conference and outgoing calls for the team
  • Identifying and retrieving information necessary to support legal decision-making
  • Being a team player and assist others within the team / firm whenever possible
  • Taking up any urgent or ad-hoc tasks as may be allocated by the fee earners as well as working through various deadlines
  • Such other duties as the firm may reasonably require from time to time

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Previous legal experience or relevant legal studies completed (LLB/GDL/LPC/PCLL or equivalent)
  • Prior experience in offshore sector and/or assisting with US IPOs and other corporate transactions will be highly regarded
  • Ability to pay attention to details and produce works with a good degree of accuracy
  • Have a great sense of responsibility and have the ability to work independently and proactively
  • Proficient in Word/Outlook and a working knowledge of Excel
  • Administrative and document management experience will be a plus
  • Have excellent organisation, administration and communication skills to undertake work at a high-level and of a confidential nature
  • Ability to efficiently manage own time and prioritise workflow with reference to key deadlines
  • Ability to adapt to the continual roll-out of innovative tools and processes
  • Supportive of and able to demonstrate agile and flexible working
  • Excellent communication skills in English, Cantonese and Mandarin (written and spoken)
